curriculum.name: emails_about
curriculum.goal: Given a topic, return all the emails about that topic.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE emails_about(topic:TOPIC)
$v0 = FIND EMAIL WHERE SELF.TOPIC={topic}
RETURN $v0
END
